transitions.accepts: repository package manifest lockfile and effective pinned pnpm configuration
transitions.emits: success only for the reviewed effective overrides and matching lock entries
transitions.failure: rejects ignored malformed missing duplicate stale or unverified settings
transitions.invariant: the probe reads configuration without installing packages or running scripts

transitions.accepts: UTF-8 bytes from one selected governed source file
transitions.emits: declarations and contract comment locations from its AST
transitions.failure: rejects parse diagnostics forbidden syntax and ignored diagnostics
transitions.invariant: source text is parsed but never evaluated

transitions.accepts: one lexical scope and inherited authority-name state
transitions.emits: authority names visible after runtime shadow declarations
transitions.failure: preserves inherited authority when a declaration is ambient or unsafe
transitions.invariant: namespace scope analysis never erases runtime authority use

transitions.accepts: raw manifest text from the selected repository
transitions.failure: rejects malformed or noncanonical manifest state
transitions.invariant: unvalidated fields never reach source inspection

transitions.accepts: a closed manifest and selected fixed repository roots
transitions.emits: success only after exhaustive AST and contract verification
transitions.failure: rejects stale missing duplicate or forbidden transition state
transitions.invariant: the stable compiler API parses source without executing modules
